## `startLogin`

[source](login.aug#L11)

**Inputs and dependencies**

- `crypto`: [`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto). Get this dependency from the composition; the caller does not supply it. Read reference values without copying them.
- `clock`: [`Clock`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock). Get this dependency from the composition; the caller does not supply it. Read reference values without copying them.

- `transactions`: [`ExpiringStore<LoginTransaction>`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore). Get this dependency from the composition; the caller does not supply it. Read reference values without copying them.

Result: `HttpResponse<Html>`.

Capabilities: [`crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random), [`crypto.sha256`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.sha256), [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now), [`client.request`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-HttpClient.request), [`transactions.put`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put).

HTTP route: `GET` `/login/start`. Return status 200 on success. An unhandled request failure returns status 500 and cancels its request tasks.

Declared HTTP failures: [`SessionError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-SessionError) returns status 502; `CryptoError` returns status 503; `TimeError` returns status 503; [`StoreFull`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-StoreFull) returns status 503.

**Author documentation**

Start a browser-bound, short-lived transaction. The PKCE verifier stays on the server.

**Behavior when execution reaches this operation**

- Set `config` to the result of call [`settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-settings).
- Set `document` to the result of call [`discover`](protocol.aug.md#symbol-discover); supply dependencies `client` from `client`.
- Set `browser` to the result of call `base64url` on the result of call [`Crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) on `crypto` with `size` set to `32`.
- Set `state` to the result of call `base64url` on the result of call [`Crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) on `crypto` with `size` set to `32`.
- Set `nonce` to the result of call `base64url` on the result of call [`Crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) on `crypto` with `size` set to `32`.
- Set `verifier` to the result of call `base64url` on the result of call [`Crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) on `crypto` with `size` set to `32`.
- Set `transaction` to the result of call [`LoginTransaction`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LoginTransaction) with `state` set to `state`; `nonce` set to `nonce`; `verifier` set to `verifier`; `expires` set to (the result of call [`Clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now) on `clock` plus `300`).
- Call [`ExpiringStore.put`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put) on `transactions` with `key` set to `browser`; `value` set to `transaction`; `expires` set to `expires` of `transaction`; `now` set to the result of call [`Clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now) on `clock`.
- Set `challenge` to the result of call `base64url` on the result of call [`Crypto.sha256`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.sha256) on `crypto` with `input` set to the result of call `bytes` on `verifier`.
- Set `location` to (((((((((((`authorization_endpoint` of `document` plus `"?response_type=code&client_id="`) plus the result of call [`urlEncode`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-urlEncode) with `input` set to `clientId` of `config`) plus `"&redirect_uri="`) plus the result of call [`urlEncode`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-urlEncode) with `input` set to `callback` of `config`) plus `"&scope=openid%20profile&state="`) plus the result of call [`urlEncode`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-urlEncode) with `input` set to `state`) plus `"&nonce="`) plus the result of call [`urlEncode`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-urlEncode) with `input` set to `nonce`) plus `"&code_challenge="`) plus the result of call [`urlEncode`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/web/contracts.aug.md#symbol-urlEncode) with `input` set to `challenge`) plus `"&code_challenge_method=S256"`).
- Set `headers` to the result of call [`withCookie`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-withCookie) with `headers` set to the result of call `with` on the result of call [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) with `name` set to `"location"`; `value` set to `location`; `name` set to `"aug_login"`; `value` set to `browser`; `path` set to `"/login"`; `maxAge` set to `300`; `secure` set to `secureCookies` of `config`.

**Author documentation**

Exchange a one-use code over HTTP, verify the provider JWT/JWKS and UserInfo subject, then issue a distinct app-session JWT.

## Language rules

Boolean operations short-circuit from left to right. int uses signed 64-bit values; addition, subtraction, multiplication, and negation wrap. Division by zero raises ArithmeticError. float uses double precision. Tuples and records compare by value; mutable collections and behavioral classes compare by identity. Optional values contain a value or null; omission becomes null. Managed references grant read access; ownership moves and mutable borrows remain checked. A scope joins its child tasks; an unhandled child failure cancels siblings. See the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/reference) for shared rules.
